plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-09-30 from UML's official 'Degree Pathway for Computer Science, General Option' (Academic Catalog, Kennedy College of Sciences, fetched live). catalog_year=2026-2027 reflects the catalog edition in which this pathway is published (the UML catalog site currently publishes the 2026 edition; other departments show 'fall 2026 and beyond' pathways). The pathway itself is officially versioned 'For students who entered fall 2020 and beyond' (page dp-cs-general-2020.aspx). Degree name per UML's official program page: 'Computer Science Major, Bachelor of Science (B.S.)'; the general option is the plain/no-concentration track (options also offered: Data Science, Cybersecurity, Bio-Cheminformatics). Semester totals as printed: 14+14+14+16+16+16+15+15 = 120, which matches the catalog's own 'Total Minimum Credits = 120' exactly; no discrepancy. MATH sequence note (catalog footnote 1): the student's math sequence is determined by ALEKS placement score and/or AP credit; Calculus IA/IB may be required instead of Calculus I. No prerequisites are published on the pathway page, so every prereq list is empty; nothing was invented. ENGL.1010 College Writing I and HONR.1100 First Year Seminar in Honors are an either/or choice slot. The catalog prints the project course and CS electives as COMP.xxxx; these became distinct choice slots (COMP.PROJ1/2, COMP.ELECT1/2) so no placeholder code repeats. Core Curriculum notes from the page: DCA and SRE Essential Learning Outcomes are fulfilled outside the CS major; no more than two Breadth of Knowledge courses may share the same prefix; courses in slots may be taken in any order subject to prerequisites.
